estimation._note: Cross-port GLMM estimation defaults (single home). wald_se: 'hessian' (the SE glmer's summary reports for a fit that is not singular; at a singular fit glmer reports the Schur SE, and MCPower keeps the Hessian) is the default; 'rx' is the faster Schur SE. nagq: 1 = Laplace. df_method: 'auto' is the default and picks the test per design (between-within df for a single-grouping LMM without a primary random slope and for any single-grouping GLMM, Satterthwaite df for any other LMM, Wald z for a crossed or nested GLMM); 'between_within', 'satterthwaite' and 'asymptotic' name one test each. Mirrors the contract's serde Default impls (WaldSe::default, default_nagq, DfMethod::default) — change together.

benchmarks._odds_note: beta. log(OR) for OR = 1.5 / 2.5 / 4.0 (Chen, Cohen & Chen 2010). Logit-outcome presets only; values are on the β (log-odds) wire scale.

limits._sample_size_base_note: Green's rule of thumb: N >= sample_size_base + the number of design columns.

text.required_n_ci_footnote: Required N from the model-based crossing fit (isotonic); CI by Wilson band inversion, rounded outward.
text.required_n_ci_footnote_appr: appr. = probit extrapolation beyond the search range — rerun with a higher `to` to confirm.
text.required_n_ci_footnote_suppressed: — = fit suppressed ({labels}: non-monotone within the grid).
text.required_n_ci_footnote_floor: ≤ = target reached at or below the search floor — rerun with a lower `from` to localise.
text.non_monotone_warning: ⚠ {label}: power not monotone in N (max drop {drop} > MC noise); model-based fit suppressed — grid value shown.
